chunked_commit_experiment.implementation: /tmp Objective-C prototype with MTLSharedEvent preserving rotation dependencies and union of chunk GPU intervals
chunked_commit_experiment.interpretation: Chunked commit increased encoder/commit/event overhead and was worse than the single native command buffer; no performance claim.

external_suggestion_review.icb_scalar_root_cause: not_established: this v2 GEMM has compile-time M/N/K and only three buffer arguments, not scalar buffer(3..5)
external_suggestion_review.nax_device_boundary: closed: NAX is M5-only and not the M4 Max MLX dispatch path
external_suggestion_review.single_encoder_mve: not_applicable: production run_pipeline already creates one encoder per command buffer, outside the rep loop

mlx_geometry_and_nax.interpretation: MLX geometry alone does not identify the kernel; NAX requires the MetalPerformancePrimitives SDK header and a correct wrapper. The current wrapper is not correctness evidence and is not production.
mlx_geometry_and_nax.nax_availability: not_applicable_to_m4_max: MLX gates NAX with metal::is_nax_available(); NAX is the M5 Neural Accelerator path

ordinary_steel.interpretation: The ordinary M4 Steel wrapper is correct, proving the non-NAX reuse route, but its measurements were not stably better than golden and later runs were noisy; no publication.
ordinary_steel.source: self-contained public MLX GEMMKernel/BlockLoader/BlockMMA, BM=BN=64, BK=16, WM=WN=2, three-buffer ABI

mlx_timestamp_hook.batch_protocol: lazy construction outside timing, mx.eval of 500 calls per batch, alternating hook off/on in one process
mlx_timestamp_hook.implementation: /tmp Objective-C runtime commit-hook prototype with completed handlers and union of overlapping command-buffer intervals
mlx_timestamp_hook.interpretation: The hook can expose MLX command-buffer GPU intervals, but summing overlapping intervals is invalid and the observed wall perturbation is not negligible; diagnostic only.

native_batch.implementation: /tmp Objective-C dynamic-library prototype; single stage, three buffers, no workspace fill
native_batch.interpretation: Native encoding removes most of the Python path overhead, but all measured variants still exceed 1.10; different runs are not a kernel ranking or publishable evidence.
native_batch.prepare_boundary: cached ctypes pointer/offset arrays; no GPU work or input computation
native_batch.timed_boundary: native commandBuffer creation + all encoding + commit + waitUntilCompleted

native_batch_python_parity.dylib_trust: fixed harness source rebuilt per process outside timing; pre-existing dylib caches are not trusted

output_store_optimization.change: removed the redundant TransformNone float -> half -> float pre-pass; Ctile.store<half> performs the single output rounding

official_full_run.interpretation: The official full run can match or beat MLX in a quiet prototype, but results are not stable across fresh runs; no cherry-picked completion or publication.
official_full_run.method: self-contained MLX GEMMKernel::run with compile-time GEMMParams, direct single-round output store, and the production native batch encoder
